4th rowMisclassification hallucination reclassifies a normal finding as a lesion, which might be believable due to similar terminology in colonoscopy reports.
5th rowUncertainty avoidance bias provides a definitive answer despite lack of evidence, which is common in clinical settings where certainty is preferred.
